The '''''Athallian Messenger''''' was a [[Courier/Legends|courier]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with a cargo of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] at some point by [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. Many [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]] subsequently searched for the vessel without success. Sometime by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Eirrauc]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] [[Daushoroc]] and [[Tamoss]] also attempted to find the ''Messenger'' in order to use the profits from the search to liberate other members of their [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]].

==History==
[[File:Daushoroc.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The trader Daushoroc was one of many who searched for the wreck of the ''Athallian Messenger''.]]
The ''Athallian Messenger'' was a [[Courier/Legends|courier]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="Galaxy9" /> that shared its name with [[Athallia]], a celestial body<ref name="RoguesGallery">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}}</ref> in the [[Athallia system/Legends|Athallia system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Athallia sector/Legends|same name]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> At some point by [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="36 BBY" /> it crash-landed on<ref name="Galaxy9" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] while carrying a shipment of ancient [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]]. [[Sandstorm/Legends|Sandstorms]] soon consumed the wreck of the ship.<ref name="Galaxy9" />

Over the subsequent four [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], many [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]] unsuccessfully sought the ''Athallian Messenger'', with most of them disappearing in the process. Members of<ref name="Galaxy9" /> Tatooine's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TEA" /> refused to search for the vessel, although they did trade a [[Map/Legends|map]] and several vague clues to the [[Eirrauc]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] [[Daushoroc]] and [[Tamoss]] when they arrived on Tatooine to join the search<ref name="Galaxy9" /> at some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="36 BBY" />

Daushoroc expected to earn thirty to forty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] if their endeavor was successful, [[Currency/Legends|money]] the two traders intended to use to help liberate their fellow Eirraucs from [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When the pair encountered in the desert a group of Tatooine's<ref name="Galaxy9" /> other<ref name="TEA" /> native species, the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], the Eirraucs offered [[Water/Legends|water]] and a [[Tusken battle talisman]] to the group's elder. Daushoroc subsequently showed the elder an image of the ''Athallian Messenger'' on the [[Viewscreen/Legends|screen]] of their [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], after which the Tusken Raider pointed the traders in the direction of a distant [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range.<ref name="Galaxy9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Athallian Messenger'' appeared on a screen in the short story "[[Wanderer of Worlds]]," written by [[John Dunivant]] and published in the [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''<ref name="Galaxy9" /> in [[October]] [[1996]].<ref name="SWGM8">[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 8|''Star Wars Galaxy Magazine'' 8]]</ref>
